## Cores

### ULX3S/ULX4M USB DFU bootloader (had2019-playground) (best) {#core-had2019-dfu-bootloader}

The gateware ULX3S/ULX4M ship from flash address 0: PicoRV32 + no2usb-derived USB device core enumerating as DFU 1d50:614b, writing the user bitstream to flash 0x200000 via a QSPI master, with a 6-zone alt-setting layout. Fully documented in docs/DFUs.md.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repository | [emard__had2019-playground](https://github.com/emard/had2019-playground): HAD2019 badge playground |
| Files | [`projects/bootloader/rtl`](https://github.com/emard/had2019-playground/tree/0723f2a536b20f26ec1b2d5cf1dcc2b5355b6808/projects/bootloader/rtl), [`projects/bootloader/fw`](https://github.com/emard/had2019-playground/tree/0723f2a536b20f26ec1b2d5cf1dcc2b5355b6808/projects/bootloader/fw), [`cores/usb/rtl`](https://github.com/emard/had2019-playground/tree/0723f2a536b20f26ec1b2d5cf1dcc2b5355b6808/cores/usb/rtl) |
| Top module | `top` |
| Language | Verilog, C |
| License | per file: bootloader RTL BSD-3-Clause, USB core + DFU firmware LGPL-3.0-or-later, picorv32.v ISC (see docs/DFUs.md) |
| FPGA / primitives | ECP5: `TRELLIS_IO`, `OFS1P3DX`, `IDDRX1F`, `USRMCLK` |
| Tests | none found (cores/usb/sim + project tbs are waveform-only, never run to a pass/fail check) |

**On ULX3S:** USER_BITSTREAM_ADDR, dfu_zones[0] (fw/usb_dfu.c) and ecpmulti --address must all agree; PROGRAMN (LPF site M4) must loop back for hand-off.

### Fomu foboot DFU bootloader (LiteX/VexRiscv + ValentyUSB eptri) {#core-foboot-dfu-bootloader}

LiteX/Migen-generated SoC on a VexRiscv CPU with ValentyUSB's eptri (TriEndpointInterface) USB device peripheral providing the DFU class in a single alt-0 interface; boots the flashed user image after a timeout unless the two Fomu touch pads are bridged to force staying in DFU.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repository | [im-tomu__foboot](https://github.com/im-tomu/foboot): Foboot: the Fomu iCE40 UP5K failsafe USB DFU bootloader, LiteX/Migen SoC |
| Files | [`hw/rtl/VexRiscv_Fomu.v`](https://github.com/im-tomu/foboot/blob/dfa09fc84b0acb4d9a2d409f3a381274a1551e9f/hw/rtl/VexRiscv_Fomu.v), [`hw/rtl/spimemio.v`](https://github.com/im-tomu/foboot/blob/dfa09fc84b0acb4d9a2d409f3a381274a1551e9f/hw/rtl/spimemio.v), [`hw/deps/valentyusb/valentyusb/usbcore`](https://github.com/im-tomu/foboot/tree/dfa09fc84b0acb4d9a2d409f3a381274a1551e9f/hw/deps/valentyusb/valentyusb/usbcore) |
| Top module | `VexRiscv` |
| Language | Verilog (SpinalHDL-generated VexRiscv core), Python/Migen (SoC + USB peripheral, hw/*.py), C (sw/) |
| License | foboot itself Apache-2.0 (LICENSE); ValentyUSB submodule BSD-3-Clause (hw/deps/valentyusb/LICENSE) |
| FPGA / primitives | iCE40: none (portable) |
| Tests | hw/deps/valentyusb/sim (cocotb, test-eptri.py/cocotb-eptri.py): self-checking, raises TestFailure/uses assertEqual; none found for the SoC or bootloader firmware itself |

**On ULX3S:** Architecturally unlike every other bootloader-dfu entry here: a LiteX/Migen SoC generated by Python, not hand-written RTL, needing the LiteX build flow rather than a plain yosys+nextpnr Makefile. Its migen/litex/litedram/litex-boards/spibone/compiler_rt submodules were deliberately not fetched in this clone (only hw/deps/valentyusb was), so it cannot be rebuilt from this clone.

### Hazard3-Doom vendored DFU bootloader (ULX4M-LD validated) {#core-hazard3-doom-dfu-bootloader}

Self-contained fork of the had2019 bootloader (own mk/, cores/, no external Makefile deps), remapped buttons, validated on real ULX4M-LD v0.0.3 (LFE5UM-85F) hardware, with a byte-for-byte readback recovery procedure documented in README_ULX4M_BOOTLOADER.md.

### Machdyne tinydfu-bootloader (ECP5, TinyFPGA-derived USB core) {#core-tinydfu-bootloader-core}

Per-board ECP5 DFU bootloader (Lakritz/Obst/Konfekt/etc.), always resident at flash 0 and auto-booting the user partition after a timer unless DFU activity intervenes. USB device core is a bit-banged full-speed PHY+SIE (usb_fs_*.v) plus usb_dfu_core.v, adapted by Lawrie Griffiths/Owen Kirby from Luke Valenti's original TinyFPGA bootloader core (per usb_dfu_core.v header) - a third, independent USB-device lineage distinct from no2usb and ValentyUSB.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repository | [machdyne__tinydfu-bootloader](https://github.com/machdyne/tinydfu-bootloader): TinyDFU Bootloader: multi-board USB DFU bootloader |
| Files | [`usb/usb_dfu_core.v`](https://github.com/machdyne/tinydfu-bootloader/blob/681f57090774cfe52d77358736fe53f6371c6b3d/usb/usb_dfu_core.v), [`usb/usb_dfu_ctrl_ep.v`](https://github.com/machdyne/tinydfu-bootloader/blob/681f57090774cfe52d77358736fe53f6371c6b3d/usb/usb_dfu_ctrl_ep.v), [`boards/lakritz/tinydfu_lakritz.v`](https://github.com/machdyne/tinydfu-bootloader/blob/681f57090774cfe52d77358736fe53f6371c6b3d/boards/lakritz/tinydfu_lakritz.v), [`boards/lakritz/boardinfo.vh`](https://github.com/machdyne/tinydfu-bootloader/blob/681f57090774cfe52d77358736fe53f6371c6b3d/boards/lakritz/boardinfo.vh) |
| Top module | `tinydfu_lakritz` |
| Language | Verilog |
| License | Apache-2.0 (LICENSE.txt) |
| FPGA / primitives | ECP5: `USRMCLK` |
| Tests | testbenches/i2c_master_tb.v only (unrelated I2C helper); no USB/DFU-core testbench found |

**On ULX3S:** Not ULX3S; fills the ECP5 gap in this list with a bootloader that is neither no2usb- nor ValentyUSB-derived. VID:PID 0x16d0:0x116d is per-board, hardcoded in each boards/<name>/boardinfo.vh (BOARD_VID/BOARD_PID localparams). Flash split varies by board: 1 MB boot/0x100000 user on kaugummi/klinge/konfekt/kopflos/minze/schoko, 256 KB boot/0x040000 user on lakritz and obst.

### no2bootloader (Nitro) iCE40 UP5K DFU bootloader {#core-no2bootloader-dfu}

Complete multi-board iCE40 UP5K DFU bootloader (PicoRV32 SoC + no2usb device core): alt 0 = iCE40 bitstream, alt 1 = RISC-V firmware; SB_WARMBOOT cycles between a boot stub (0x004000), the DFU image (0x040000) and two app images (0x080000/0x0c0000). Used by iCEBreaker-bitsy, reDIP-SID, icE1usb.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repository | [no2fpga__no2bootloader](https://github.com/no2fpga/no2bootloader): Nitro Bootloader: iCE40 UP5K DFU bootloader |
| Files | [`gateware/ice40/rtl`](https://github.com/no2fpga/no2bootloader/tree/37dda02fba084f85f6da31ee228d3bbabbb91add/gateware/ice40/rtl), [`gateware/cores/no2usb`](https://github.com/no2fpga/no2bootloader/tree/37dda02fba084f85f6da31ee228d3bbabbb91add/gateware/cores/no2usb), [`firmware/fw_dfu.c`](https://github.com/no2fpga/no2bootloader/blob/37dda02fba084f85f6da31ee228d3bbabbb91add/firmware/fw_dfu.c) |
| Top module | `top` |
| Language | Verilog, C |
| License | HDL CERN-OHL-P-2.0 (own RTL in gateware/ice40/rtl and gateware/cores/no2usb, per LICENSE.md); this repo's firmware GPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE.md); no2usb stack LGPL-3.0-or-later, MIT for the tinyusb-driver-reused parts (gateware/cores/no2usb/LICENSE.md) |
| FPGA / primitives | iCE40: `SB_PLL40_2F_CORE`, `SB_PLL40_2F_PAD`, `SB_IO`, `SB_WARMBOOT`, `SB_HFOSC`, `SB_GB` |
| Tests | gateware/ice40/sim/{top_tb.v,dfu_helper_tb.v} + cores/{no2usb,no2misc,no2ice40}/sim: iverilog compile only, no vvp run found in the Makefiles - waveform-only |

**On ULX3S:** iCE40 UP5K only (SB_WARMBOOT/SB_PLL40_2F); no ECP5 port in this collection. gateware/build (no2build) submodule was deliberately not fetched here, so this clone cannot actually be synthesized or simulated.

### no2usb DFU runtime + dfu_helper.v (iCE40) {#core-no2usb-dfu-helper}

Button debouncer that reboots into the no2bootloader DFU image via SB_WARMBOOT (long press) or resets the app (short press); the DFU class firmware itself (usb_dfu.c/usb_dfu_rt.c) lives in the fetched no2usb submodule.

|---|---|

| FPGA / primitives | iCE40: `SB_WARMBOOT` |
| Tests | none found for dfu_helper.v itself |

**On ULX3S:** iCE40-only (SB_WARMBOOT multiboot); porting to ECP5 needs a different warm-boot mechanism plus the no2bootloader project, which is not in this collection.

### TinyFPGA USB Bootloader (USB-serial-to-SPI-flash bridge) {#core-tinyfpga-usb-bootloader}

Full-speed USB device MAC/PHY presenting a virtual serial port bridged to SPI-flash read/write/erase commands, so a host programmer can reflash the FPGA's config/user images with no separate USB-JTAG chip; common/ core has no vendor primitives, only the per-board top does.

| | |
|---|---|
| Repository | [tinyfpga__tinyfpga-bootloader](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader): TinyFPGA USB Bootloader: USB virtual-serial-to-SPI-flash-bridge gateware bootloader; |
| Files | [`common/usb_fs_rx.v`](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader/blob/97f6353540bf7c0d27f5612f202b48f41da75299/common/usb_fs_rx.v), [`common/usb_fs_tx.v`](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader/blob/97f6353540bf7c0d27f5612f202b48f41da75299/common/usb_fs_tx.v), [`common/usb_fs_pe.v`](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader/blob/97f6353540bf7c0d27f5612f202b48f41da75299/common/usb_fs_pe.v), [`common/usb_serial_ctrl_ep.v`](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader/blob/97f6353540bf7c0d27f5612f202b48f41da75299/common/usb_serial_ctrl_ep.v), [`common/usb_spi_bridge_ep.v`](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader/blob/97f6353540bf7c0d27f5612f202b48f41da75299/common/usb_spi_bridge_ep.v), [`common/tinyfpga_bootloader.v`](https://github.com/tinyfpga/TinyFPGA-Bootloader/blob/97f6353540bf7c0d27f5612f202b48f41da75299/common/tinyfpga_bootloader.v) |
| Top module | `tinyfpga_bootloader` |
| Language | Verilog |
| License | Apache-2.0 (LICENSE) |
| FPGA / primitives | iCE40 (also ported to ECP5 12F via Lattice Diamond in boards/TinyFPGA_EX, and to Xilinx Artix-7): none (portable) |
| Tests | self-checking (29 tests/*/test.v via iverilog, TAP-style asserts in expect_usb_ack() etc., tests/test.mk) |

**On ULX3S:** Not proven on ULX3S; the fielded ULX3S US2 DFU bootloader (had2019-dfu-bootloader) is unrelated (no2usb-derived). An older ULX3S bootloader, emard__tinyfpga-bootloader-ulx3s, was a direct fork of a 60MHz variant of this exact core.
